item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Laksh heating a glass beaker of water from below. He wonders whether the same idea applies to a solid metal rod heated from below.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Heated water expands, becomes lighter, and rises; cooler water moves down to replace it.
options.B: The lighter heated water sinks, and the cooler water rises to replace it.
options.C: In a solid metal rod heated from below, hot metal particles rise through the rod and cooler ones move down.
options.D: Convection in the beaker begins only when the water boils and bubbles appear.
